notes.title: Annual Mini Update
notes.notes:
Hey Absorber players,

Sorry for the long wait! I’m excited to share the latest update with you. Your feedback has been invaluable, and I’ve been working hard to bring you some cool new features and improvements. Here’s what’s new in this version:

New Features
Localization:
To make Absorber more accessible to players around the world, I’ve added support for these languages:

Korean
Arabic
Polish
Brazilian Portuguese
Turkish
Italian

New Enemies:
Get ready for new challenges! I’ve added 2 new enemies for you to face. Let me know how you fare against these new foes!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44274344/8c9137a7153ce0fd3a67175be0ab0f4ab6156b61.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44274344/9f68b8d3ce5ffa0f4a45c3d4cd7f12d470b5be7f.png

Image Chooser is Back:
By popular demand, the Image Chooser feature is back! Thanks for your feedback, and I hope this makes your experience even better. (Even if I still think my artwork isn’t that great.)

Improvements
Minor UI Reworks:
I’ve made some small tweaks to the UI to make it more user-friendly and visually appealing. I hope these changes make your gameplay smoother.

Thank you so much for your support and feedback. I couldn’t have done this without you. I hope you enjoy these new additions and improvements. As always, I’d love to hear your thoughts and suggestions.

Happy gaming!

SchlaueWurst, solo dev of Absorber
